candidates.instruction: Keep the top interface and `// @latency 0` annotation, and replace the current 4-bit count representation with a 3-bit count that resets to 0, becomes 1 on a `noisy`/candidate mismatch, increments on matching cycles until 7, then holds at 7. When the prior count is 7 and `noisy` still matches the candidate, update `clean` to the candidate; preserve synchronous active-high reset of candidate, count, and clean.
